scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend" || npm --prefix frontend run dev & npm --prefix backend run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix && npm --prefix backend run lint:fix
scripts.check: npm --prefix backend run check:env && npm --prefix backend run test:endpoints
